thread:
tara: FYI console team saw inconsistent invoice-preview deltas in EU canary this morning. A few tenants reported token counts 2x for the same session.
vishal: any logs or a sample event?
tara: grabbed a pair from the preview pipeline: the canonical ledger got one event but preview aggregator got two different enriched events: 
```json
{"req":"q-9z","tenant":"tn-42","tokens":80,"route_tag":"primary","enrich_ver":"r1"}
{"req":"q-9z","tenant":"tn-42","tokens":80,"route_tag":"fallback","enrich_ver":"r2"}
```
emily: sounds like enrichment divergence + aggregator windowing. For final billing that's expected if both route_tag events are canonical, but preview should probably collapse to a single representative charge.
nate: question: do we collapse by req_id or by session? Some customers intentionally fan-out to multiple routes and expect multiple charges.
vishal: right. We must not alter ledger semantics. We're only fixing console preview. options: (A) change aggregator to collapse by stable_resolution_id if present, (B) add a preview_mode flag so enrichment emits preview=true and routing can opt into collapse, (C) hide preview for EU canary until we resolve.
tara: Finance says they don't want any backend heuristics that might trick customers; prefer explicit preview flag. But Design is worried about hiding features mid-rollout.
ux-bot: @design handle: suggested tooltip copy: "Preview numbers are estimates; transient routing duplicates may be collapsed for display."

vishal: implement plan I propose: 1) emit route_resolution_hash in enrichment events (no dedupe change), 2) preview aggregator checks for route_resolution_hash and collapses events that share same req + resolution hash within 90s for display only, 3) emit a metric meter.preview.collapsed.count. Shadow run for 7 days.
emily: metric needs tags: tenant, env, enrich_ver, route_resolution_hash. Also add meter.preview.tokens.delta so Product can see magnitude.
nate: canary hotfix: flip feature flag invoice.preview.show = false for env=canary-eu until collapse patch is live. deploy-bot: Nate requested toggle invoice.preview.show=false for env=canary-eu. (done)
tara: thanks. Can we also log which pipeline stage emitted duplicates? We saw enrich-proxy retrying acks earlier in trace.
vishal: I instrumented enrichment-proxy to stamp outbound events with enrich_attempt and ack_token. If enrich_attempt>1 then tag as retry in preview metric.
emily: small UX ask: show a subtle badge "preview (collapsed)" when collapse occurs, with link to explanation. ux-bot: noted and will spin copy.

nate: implementation detail for aggregator: keep an in-memory LRU of recent req keys with (first_seen_ts, aggregated_tokens, resolution_hashes_seen) and a TTL of 90s. When a new event arrives, if req key present and resolution_hashes differ but we're in preview-mode, mark as collapsed and update aggregated_tokens (for display) but also record original events to shadow log for audits.
vishal: make sure shadow logs are written to S3 with encryption and include original_event_id so billing audits can replay if needed.
tara: timeline: hide preview for EU canary (done), push route_resolution_hash emitter to canary (today), wire preview collapse behind feature flag and run shadow (tomorrow), enable display collapse for internal tenants after 24h shadow, then EU internal canary after 7 days if no regressions.
emily: also notify CS for any tenants that reported spikes. billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4801 "EU canary preview double-counting - investigation & customer outreach" and attached audit traces.

vishal: one more thought: sampling. Some preview flows sample token counts (to reduce noise) and then multiply. That interacts badly with collapsing; we should collapse before any expansion factor is applied. Add unit tests for expansion+collapse order.
nate: agreed. I'll add tests and a dashboard card showing collapsed vs raw tokens over time.
tara: ok folks, let's keep this thread updated when PRs land. If anyone finds the enrich-store ack window is the root cause we may need a small retry backoff.
emily: I'll coordinate design copy for the tooltip and the in-console audit link.
vishal: PRs: enrichment change (open), aggregator collapse (WIP). I'll post links here once ready.
(tara pinned actions: feature-flag hide for canary, emit route_resolution_hash shadow, aggregator collapse shadow for 7d, metric & dashboard card, customer ticket BILL-4801)
